product.name: Lians
product.category: Decision evidence and reconstruction for regulated AI
product.summary: Lians keeps a portable, provider-neutral record of what an AI system knew, retrieved, did, and reviewed so consequential decisions can be reconstructed and verified later.

workflow.label: Capture
workflow.detail: Record prompts, retrieved context, tool calls, outputs, policies, and review events as a decision is made.

workflow.label: Reconstruct
workflow.detail: Replay the evidence trail to show what the system knew and why it produced a consequential result.

workflow.label: Verify
workflow.detail: Check evidence integrity, policy application, reviewer actions, and the exact chain behind a decision.

workflow.label: Monitor
workflow.detail: Track later changes to evidence, policies, models, and outcomes without losing the original record.

surfaces.label: Library
surfaces.detail: Local-first Python library backed by SQLite for embedding decision evidence directly in an application.

surfaces.label: Self-hosted server
surfaces.detail: Team deployment backed by Postgres and pgvector for shared evidence, controls, and investigation workflows.

surfaces.label: Cloud
surfaces.detail: Managed Lians service for teams that want the evidence layer operated for them.
